en.headline: Observatory raises yellow fire danger warning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 6am on Saturday, saying the fire risk is fairly high.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 6am on Saturday. The warning means the fire risk is fairly high, and it was still in force in the early morning.
The Observatory reminded the public to stay alert and to take the usual fire precautions. A yellow signal is the lower of the two fire danger warnings; a red warning would mean the risk is extreme.

No rainstorm, thunderstorm or tropical cyclone signal was reported in force with the fire warning. Hikers and people using country parks were among those the signal is meant to alert on a dry morning.

zh.headline: 天文台上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 香港天文台周六上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，呼籲市民提高警覺。
body: 香港天文台周六上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告。警告表示火災危險性頗高，清晨時分仍然生效。
天文台提醒市民特別提高警覺，並採取適當防火措施。黃色是兩級火災危險警告中較低的一級；紅色則表示危險性極高。
與這項警告同時，未有接獲暴雨、雷暴或熱帶氣旋信號生效的公布。警告亦提醒使用郊野公園及行山的人士，在乾燥的早上要小心火種。
